classes.name: Enset Bacterial Wilt
classes.visual_pattern: Central heart-leaf yellowing, petiole drooping, and yellow bacterial fluid evident when the pseudostem is cut.
classes.visual_pattern_am: የመሃል ቅጠል መገርጠት፣ የግንድ መደፈር እና ግንዱ ሲቆረጥ ቢጫ የባክቴሪያ ፈሳሽ መታየት።
advice: Uproot and bury the infected plant immediately in a deep pit away from the farm.
Flame-sterilize or wash slicing knives with a 10% bleach solution after every cut.
Do not replant Enset in the same hole for 6–12 months; keep the soil exposed to direct sunlight.
advice_am: የተያዘውን ተክል ወዲያውኑ ቆፍረው ከእርሻ ርቆ በጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ይቅበሩ።
ከእያንዳንዱ ቁረጥ በኋላ ቢላዎችን በእሳት ወይም በ10% ብሊች ይታጠቡ።
ለ6–12 ወራት በተመሳሳይ ጉድጓድ እንሰት አይተክሉ፤ አፈሩን ለፀሀይ ያጋልጡ።

food_loss.note: Estimated household Kocho and Bulla food reserve loss per infected plant.
food_loss.note_am: በአንድ የተያዘ ተክል የሚጠፋ የኩቾ እና የቡላ የቤት ምግብ ክምችት ግምት።

sanitation.priority: Flame-sterilize Macha harvesting knives before and after every cut to prevent farm-to-farm transmission.
sanitation.priority_am: ከእርሻ ወደ እርሻ እንዳይተላለፍ የማቻ መከር ቢላዎችን ከመቁረጥ በፊት እና በኋላ በእሳት ያጸዱ።

classes.seasonality: Rainy season (June–September), when soil moisture is high.
classes.seasonality_am: የዝናብ ወቅት (ሰኔ–መስከረም)፣ የአፈር እርጥበት ከፍ ባለበት ጊዜ።
classes.transmission: Infected planting material, contaminated cutting tools, and soil movement.
classes.transmission_am: የተያዘ የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ፣ የተበከሉ መቁረጫ መሳሪያዎች እና የአፈር እንቅስቃሴ።
classes.yield_impact: Up to 100% plant loss — whole mats can be destroyed.
classes.yield_impact_am: እስከ 100% የተክል ኪሳራ — ሙሉ እንሰቶች ሊጠፉ ይችላሉ።
home_remedies: Traditional: sprinkle ash from burnt enset leaves around the base of healthy plants to deter spread.
Easy: never re-use a cutting knife without passing it through fire first — this is free and stops the disease moving plant to plant.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ ጤናማ ተክሎችን ለመከላከል በእንሰት ስር ከተቃጠለ ቅጠል የተገኘ አመድ ይረጩ።
ቀላል፡ የመቁረጫ ቢላዋን በእሳት ሳያሳልፉ እንደገና አይጠቀሙ — ይህ ነጻ ነው እና በሽታውን ከተክል ወደ ተክል እንዳይሸጋገር ይከላከላል።
prevention_tips: Plant early and space mats widely so tools never touch neighbouring plants.
Bury infected debris deep and keep the pit open to sunlight.
prevention_tips_am: ቀድመው ይትከሉ እና እንሰቶችን በስፋት ያርቁ።
የተያዘውን ቅሪት በጥልቅ ይቅበሩ እና ጉድጓዱን ለፀሀይ ያጋልጡ።

classes.name: Enset Streak Virus
classes.regional_stats: Common in highland enset gardens; spread by mealybugs and aphids.
classes.regional_stats_am: በደጋማ እንሰት አትክልቶች የተለመደ፤ በሜሊባግ እና አፊድ ይተላለፋል።
classes.traditional_practices: Leaf pruning and burning are the most common farmer responses.
classes.traditional_practices_am: ቅጠል መቁረጥ እና ማቃጠል የተለመዱ የገበሬ ምላሾች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Continuous yellow mosaic lines and broken streaking running parallel along the leaf veins.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በቅጠል ስሮች ላይ ትይዩ የሆኑ ቀጣይ ቢጫ ሞዛይክ መስመሮች እና የተሰበሩ ጅራቶች።
advice: Prune and burn individual heavily streaked leaves to limit viral spread.
Spray a mild soap-water or neem oil solution on leaf undersides to kill mealybugs and aphids.
Avoid transferring planting materials from infected mats to new fields.
advice_am: በጣም የተጠቁትን ቅጠሎች ቆርጠው ያቃጥሉ።
ሜሊባግ እና አፊድን ለመግደል በቅጠል ስር ሳሙና-ውሃ ወይም የኒም ዘይት ይረጩ።
ከተያዙ እንሰቶች ወደ አዲስ እርሻ የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ አያስተላልፉ።
classes.seasonality: Year-round; worst during dry spells when insects are active.
classes.seasonality_am: ዓመቱን ሙሉ፤ ነፍሳት በሚንቀሳቀሱበት ደረቅ ወቅት የባሰ ነው።
classes.transmission: Mealybugs, aphids, and infected suckers (planting material).
classes.transmission_am: ሜሊባግ፣ አፊድ እና የተያዙ ችግኞች (የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ)።
classes.yield_impact: 10–30% reduced corm yield; slow plant decline.
classes.yield_impact_am: ከ10–30% የግንድ ምርት መቀነስ፤ የተክል መዳከም።
classes.monitoring_frequency: Every 2 weeks; check leaf undersides for insects.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በየ2 ሳምንቱ፤ ቅጠሎችን ስር ለነፍሳት ይፈትሹ።
home_remedies: Traditional: hang neem leaves in the garden — their smell repels aphids and mealybugs.
Easy: mix a spoon of dish soap in 2L water and spray the underside of leaves once a week.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ በአትክልቱ ውስጥ የኒም ቅጠሎችን ይስቀሉ — ሽታቸው አፊድን እና ሜሊባግን ያባርራል።
ቀላል፡ አንድ ማንኪያ ሳሙና በ2 ሊትር ውሃ ቀላቅለው በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ቅጠሎችን ስር ይረጩ።
prevention_tips: Only take suckers from healthy-looking mother plants.
Keep the garden weed-free to reduce insect hiding places.
prevention_tips_am: ችግኞችን የሚወስዱት ከጤናማ እናት ተክሎች ብቻ ይሁን።
ነፍሳት የሚደበቁበትን አረም ለማስወገድ አትክልቱን ንጹህ ያድርጉ።

classes.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
classes.regional_stats: Widespread in humid lowland and midland coffee zones.
classes.regional_stats_am: በእርጥበታማ ዝቅተኛ እና መካከለኛ የቡና አካባቢዎች በስፋት ይገኛል።
classes.traditional_practices: Shade pruning and copper sprays are the leading farmer controls.
classes.traditional_practices_am: የጥላ መቁረጥ እና የመዳብ መርጫ ዋና የገበሬ መቆጣጠሪያዎች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Bright orange or yellow powdery spots on the underside of coffee leaves.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በቡና ቅጠል ስር ደማቅ ብርቱካናማ ወይም ቢጫ የዱቄት ነጠብጣቦች።
advice: Prune overlapping canopy shade branches to increase airflow and sunlight exposure.
Apply an organic copper-based fungicide spray prior to the main rainy season.
Remove heavily infected lower foliage lying close to the soil surface.
advice_am: የአየር ዝውውር እና የፀሀይ ብርሀን ለማሳደግ የተደራረቡ የጥላ ቅርንጫፎችን ይቁረጡ።
ከዋናው የዝናብ ወቅት በፊት ኦርጋኒክ የመዳብ ፈንገስ መርጫ ይረጩ።
ከአፈር ገጽ አጠገብ ያሉ በጣም የተያዙ የታችኛው ቅጠሎችን ያስወግዱ።
classes.canopy_advisor: Under enset canopy, prune lower enset leaves and thin shade to reduce humidity and rust pressure on coffee.
classes.canopy_advisor_am: በእንሰት ጥላ ስር የታችኛውን የእንሰት ቅጠሎች ቆርጠው ጥላውን በማቅለል እርጥበትን እና የዝገት ጫናን ይቀንሱ።
classes.seasonality: Late rainy season to early dry season (August–November).
classes.seasonality_am: ከዝናብ መጨረሻ እስከ ደረቅ ወቅት መጀመሪያ (ነሀሴ–ህዳር)።
classes.transmission: Wind-borne spores; spread by rain splash between trees.
classes.transmission_am: በነፋስ የሚተላለፉ ስፖሮች፤ በዝናብ ከዛፍ ወደ ዛፍ ይተላለፋል።
home_remedies: Traditional: plant a row of maize or banana as a living windbreak around the coffee field.
Easy: pick off and burn the very first rusted leaves — one early action can stop an outbreak.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ በቡና እርሻ ዙሪያ የበቆሎ ወይም የሙዝ ረድፍ እንደ የነፋስ መከላከያ ይትከሉ።
ቀላል፡ የመጀመሪያዎቹን የተያዙ ቅጠሎች ቀልጠው ያቃጥሉ — ቀደም ያለ እርምጃ ወረርሽኝን ይከላከላል።
prevention_tips: Keep coffee rows airy by spacing trees well.
Harvest and remove fallen leaves from under the trees.
prevention_tips_am: የቡና ዛፎችን በስፋት በማስቀመጥ አየር እንዲያገኙ ያድርጉ።
ከዛፎች ስር የወደቁ ቅጠሎችን ይሰብስቡ እና ያስወግዱ።

classes.name: Coffee Brown Eye Spot
classes.regional_stats: More severe in nutrient-poor, sun-exposed nurseries.
classes.regional_stats_am: በንጥረ-ምግብ ደካማ እና ለፀሀይ በተጋለጡ የችግኝ ቦታዎች የበለጠ ከባድ ነው።
classes.traditional_practices: Mulching and compost application are common farmer responses.
classes.traditional_practices_am: መከለል እና ማዳበሪያ መጠቀም የተለመዱ የገበሬ ምላሾች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Small circular brown spots with grayish-white centers surrounded by a bright yellow halo.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በደማቅ ቢጫ ቀለበት የተከበቡ ግራጫ-ነጭ መሃል ያላቸው ትናንሽ ክብ ቡናማ ነጠብጣቦች።
advice: Apply compost or potassium-rich organic fertilizer to strengthen nutrient-deficient plants.
Place dry grass mulch around the root base to keep soil moisture and temperature stable.
Provide balanced shade in nursery beds to prevent heat stress.
advice_am: የንጥረ-ምግብ እጥረት ያለባቸውን ተክሎች ለማጠናከር ማዳበሪያ ወይም ፖታስየም የበለጸገ ኦርጋኒክ ማዳበሪያ ይጠቀሙ።
የአፈር እርጥበት እና ሙቀት እንዲረጋ በስር ደረቅ ሳር ይከልሉ።
የሙቀት ጫናን ለመከላከል በችግኝ ቦታዎች ሚዛናዊ ጥላ ይስጡ።
classes.canopy_advisor: Under enset canopy, ensure balanced shade so coffee seedlings are not heat-stressed or over-shaded.
classes.canopy_advisor_am: በእንሰት ጥላ ስር የቡና ችግኞች ከሙቀት ጫና እና ከመጠን በላይ ጥላ እንዳይደርስባቸው ሚዛናዊ ጥላ ያረጋግጡ።
classes.seasonality: Dry season and sun-exposed nursery beds.
classes.seasonality_am: ደረቅ ወቅት እና ለፀሀይ የተጋለጡ የችግኝ ቦታዎች።
classes.transmission: Rain splash and contaminated nursery tools.
classes.transmission_am: በዝናብ መርጨት እና በተበከሉ የችግኝ መሳሪያዎች።
classes.monitoring_frequency: Every 2 weeks in nurseries; monthly in mature fields.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በችግኝ ቦታዎች በየ2 ሳምንቱ፤ በአዋቂ እርሻ በየወሩ።
home_remedies: Traditional: water seedlings with diluted compost tea once a month to strengthen young plants.
Easy: raise nursery beds and thin seedlings so air moves freely between them.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ ችግኞችን ለማጠናከር በየወሩ በተቀላቀለ የማዳበሪያ ሻይ ያጠጡ።
ቀላል፡ የችግኝ ቦታዎችን ከፍ ያድርጉ እና ችግኞችን አየር እንዲያገኙ ያርቁ።
prevention_tips: Use only healthy seeds and keep nursery soil clean.
Mulch the root base to keep soil moisture and temperature stable.
prevention_tips_am: ጤናማ ዘሮችን ብቻ ይጠቀሙ እና የችግኝ አፈርን ንጹህ ያድርጉ።
የአፈር እርጥበት እና ሙቀት እንዲረጋ በስር ይከልሉ።

classes.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight
classes.regional_stats: Severe in cool, humid highland maize fields.
classes.regional_stats_am: በቀዝቃዛ እና እርጥበታማ ደጋማ የበቆሎ እርሻዎች ከባድ ነው።
classes.traditional_practices: Crop rotation and residue burning are the main farmer controls.
classes.traditional_practices_am: የሰብል ሽክርክሪት እና ቅሪት ማቃጠል ዋና የገበሬ መቆጣጠሪያዎች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Large, long, cigar-shaped grayish-tan lesions running parallel along the leaf blade.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በቅጠሉ ላይ ትይዩ የሆኑ ትላልቅ ሲጋራ ቅርጽ ያላቸው ግራጫ-ቡናማ ቁስሎች።
advice: Rotate crops next season with leguminous, nitrogen-fixing crops (haricot beans or peas).
Clear and burn or compost leftover maize stalks and leaf residue after harvest.
Plant certified disease-resistant hybrid seed varieties recommended by local extension agents.
advice_am: በሚቀጥለው ወቅት ከጥራጥሬ ሰብሎች (ባቄላ ወይም አተር) ጋር ይቀያይሩ።
ከመኸር በኋላ የቀሩ የበቆሎ ግንዶችን እና ቅጠሎችን ያጽዱ እና ያቃጥሉ።
በአካባቢ ባለሙያዎች የሚመከሩ የተረጋገጡ ተከላካይ የድብል ዘሮችን ይትከሉ።
classes.transmission: Airborne fungus spores; carried over in last season's crop residue.
classes.transmission_am: በአየር የሚተላለፉ ፈንገስ ስፖሮች፤ ካለፈው ወቅት ቅሪት ይተላለፋል።
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: ከባህላፍ መውጣት ጀምሮ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ።
home_remedies: Traditional: interplant maize with beans — the beans shade the soil and reduce leaf wetness.
Easy: never plant maize on the same plot two seasons in a row; the rotation is free and effective.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ በቆሎ ከባቄላ ጋር ይቀላቅሉ — ባቄላ አፈርን ይከልላል እና የቅጠል እርጥበትን ይቀንሳል።
ቀላል፡ በተመሳሳይ መሬት ሁለት ወቅት በተከታታይ በቆሎ አይትከሉ፤ ሽክርክሪቱ ነጻ እና ውጤታማ ነው።
prevention_tips: Burn or compost all maize stalks after harvest.
Plant resistant hybrid seeds recommended locally.
prevention_tips_am: ከመኸር በኋላ ሁሉንም የበቆሎ ግንዶች ያቃጥሉ ወይም ያበስብሉ።
በአካባቢ የሚመከሩ ተከላካይ ድብል ዘሮችን ይትከሉ።

classes.name: Maize Gray Leaf Spot
classes.regional_stats: Common in dense, humid maize plantings.
classes.regional_stats_am: በጥቅጥቅ እና እርጥበታማ የበቆሎ ተከላዎች የተለመደ።
classes.traditional_practices: Residue clearing and row spacing are the main farmer controls.
classes.traditional_practices_am: ቅሪት ማጽዳት እና የረድፍ ክፍተት ዋና የገበሬ መቆጣጠሪያዎች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Strict rectangular, narrow tan/gray lesions bounded tightly by parallel leaf veins.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በትይዩ ቅጠል ስሮች የታሰሩ ጥብቅ አራት ማዕዘን ቅርጽ ያላቸው ጠባብ ቡናማ/ግራጫ ቁስሎች።
advice: Clear post-harvest crop residue completely to eliminate overwintering fungal spores.
Maintain proper row spacing during planting to avoid trapping excess humidity between plants.
Avoid continuous maize monocropping in the same field plot.
advice_am: የክረምት ፈንገስ ስፖሮችን ለማስወገድ ከመኸር በኋላ ቅሪትን ሙሉ በሙሉ ያጽዱ።
በተክሎች መካከል እርጥበት እንዳይታሰር ትክክለኛ የረድፍ ክፍተት ይጠብቁ።
በተመሳሳይ እርሻ ተከታታይ የበቆሎ ሞኖክሮፕ ያስወግዱ።
classes.seasonality: Humid, warm months after the canopy closes.
classes.seasonality_am: ጥላው ከተዘጋ በኋላ እርጥበታማ እና ሞቃት ወራት።
classes.transmission_am: የሰብል ቅሪት እና በነፋስ የሚተላለፉ ስፖሮች።
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: ጥላው ከተዘጋ በኋላ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ።
home_remedies: Traditional: leave the plot fallow one season and plant haricot beans instead.
Easy: thin crowded plants so sunlight reaches every leaf.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ ለአንድ ወቅት መሬቱን አርፍ ያድርጉ እና በምትኩ ባቄላ ይትከሉ።
ቀላል፡ የተጨናነቁ ተክሎችን በማቅለል ፀሀይ እያንዳንዱን ቅጠል እንዲደርስ ያድርጉ።
prevention_tips: Clear all post-harvest residue completely.
Space rows well to avoid trapping humidity.
prevention_tips_am: ከመኸር በኋላ ቅሪትን ሙሉ በሙሉ ያጽዱ።
እርጥበት እንዳይታሰር ረድፎችን በስፋት ያስቀምጡ።

classes.name: Healthy Leaf Tissue
classes.regional_stats: Baseline control — no disease symptoms detected.
classes.regional_stats_am: መነሻ ቁጥጥር — ምንም የበሽታ ምልክት አልተገኘም።
classes.traditional_practices: Standard field sanitation and composting routines.
classes.traditional_practices_am: መደበኛ የእርሻ ንጽህና እና የማዳበሪያ ልምዶች።
classes.visual_pattern: Uniform green pigmentation across Enset, Coffee, or Maize leaves without spots or streaks.
classes.visual_pattern_am: ያለ ነጠብጣብ ወይም ጅራት በእንሰት፣ ቡና ወይም በቆሎ ቅጠሎች ላይ ወጥ የሆነ አረንጓዴ ቀለም።
advice: Maintain standard weeding, mulching, and organic composting routines.
Inspect fields weekly for early symptoms during high-humidity periods.
Continue good field sanitation to keep crops vigorous and productive.
advice_am: መደበኛ አረም ማጽዳት፣ መከለል እና ኦርጋኒክ ማዳበሪያ ልምዶችን ይጠብቁ።
በከፍተኛ እርጥበት ወቅት ሳምንታዊ የእርሻ ምርመራ ያድርጉ።
ሰብሎችን ጠንካራ ለማድረግ ጥሩ የእርሻ ንጽህና ይቀጥሉ።
classes.seasonality_am: ዓመቱን ሙሉ — ምንም የበሽታ ወቅት የለም።
home_remedies: Traditional: keep the farm clean with regular weeding and compost.
Easy: walk the field weekly; early signs are easier to manage than late ones.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ እርሻውን በመደበኛ አረም ማጽዳት እና ማዳበሪያ ንጹህ ያድርጉ።
ቀላል፡ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ እርሻውን ይመርምሩ፤ ቀደም ያለ ምልክት በቀላሉ ይታከማል።
prevention_tips: Keep tools clean between fields.
Compost plant residue away from the growing area.
prevention_tips_am: መሳሪያዎችን በእርሻዎች መካከል ንጹህ ያድርጉ።
የተክል ቅሪቶችን ከእርሻው ርቀው ያበስብሉ።

classes.name: Coffee Berry Disease
classes.regional_stats: Major threat in highland coffee; causes severe berry loss in wet seasons.
classes.regional_stats_am: በደጋማ ቡና ዋና ስጋት፤ በዝናባማ ወቅት ከባድ የፍሬ ኪሳራ ያስከትላል።
classes.traditional_practices: Early berry picking and removal of infected berries are common farmer controls.
classes.traditional_practices_am: ቀደም ብሎ ፍሬ መልቀም እና የተያዙ ፍሬዎችን ማስወገድ የተለመዱ የገበሬ መቆጣጠሪያዎች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Dark sunken lesions on green berries that turn black and rot; leaf spots may also appear.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በአረንጓዴ ፍሬዎች ላይ ጠቆር ያሉ የተጠመቁ ቁስሎች ወደ ጥቁር እና መበስበስ የሚሄዱ፤ የቅጠል ነጠብጣቦችም ሊታዩ ይችላሉ።
advice: Plant resistant accessions such as Gu-18, Gu-1, and Gu-4 where available.
Remove and destroy infected berries early to reduce inoculum.
Improve air circulation and avoid dense, humid canopies.
advice_am: በሚገኝበት ቦታ እንደ Gu-18፣ Gu-1 እና Gu-4 ያሉ ተከላካይ ዝርያዎችን ይትከሉ።
የበሽታ ስርጭትን ለመቀነስ የተያዙ ፍሬዎችን ቀደም ብለው ያስወግዱ እና ያጥፉ።
የአየር ዝውውርን ያሻሽሉ እና ጥቅጥቅ ያለ እርጥበታማ ጥላን ያስወግዱ።
classes.canopy_advisor: Under enset canopy, thin shade and prune lower leaves to keep coffee berries dry and reduce CBD pressure.
classes.canopy_advisor_am: በእንሰት ጥላ ስር ጥላውን በማቅለል እና የታችኛውን ቅጠሎች በመቁረጥ የቡና ፍሬዎች ደረቅ ሆነው የCBD ጫናን ይቀንሱ።
classes.seasonality: Main rainy season (May–August), when berries are still green.
classes.seasonality_am: ዋና የዝናብ ወቅት (ግንቦት–ነሀሴ)፣ ፍሬዎቹ አረንጓዴ ሲሆኑ።
classes.transmission: Rain splash from infected berries on the tree.
classes.transmission_am: በዛፉ ላይ ካሉ የተያዙ ፍሬዎች በዝናብ መርጨት።
classes.yield_impact: Up to 80% berry loss if unchecked.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: ከአበባ እስከ መኸር በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ።
home_remedies: Traditional: strip and burn all mummified berries during pruning — they carry next season's spores.
Easy: pick berries early and often; hand removal is the cheapest control.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ በመቁረጥ ወቅት የደረቁ ፍሬዎችን ሁሉ ቀልቀው ያቃጥሉ።
ቀላል፡ ፍሬዎችን ቀድመው እና በተደጋጋሚ ይልቀሙ፤ በእጅ ማስወገድ በጣም ርካሹ መቆጣጠሪያ ነው።
prevention_tips: Prune for good airflow and keep branches off the ground.
Use resistant accessions Gu-18, Gu-1, or Gu-4.
prevention_tips_am: ለጥሩ የአየር ዝውውር ይቁረጡ እና ቅርንጫፎችን ከመሬት ያርቁ።
ተከላካይ ዝርያዎችን Gu-18፣ Gu-1 ወይም Gu-4 ይጠቀሙ።

classes.name: Coffee Wilt Disease
classes.regional_stats: Destructive in lowland coffee; spreads through infected planting material and tools.
classes.regional_stats_am: በዝቅተኛ ቡና አካባቢዎች አውዳሚ፤ በተያዙ የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ እና መሳሪያዎች ይተላለፋል።
classes.traditional_practices: Uprooting and burning infected trees is the primary farmer response.
classes.traditional_practices_am: የተያዙ ዛፎችን መንቀል እና ማቃጠል ዋና የገበሬ ምላሽ ነው።
classes.visual_pattern: Sudden wilting and yellowing of branches; dark blue-black streaks in the wood; plant death.
classes.visual_pattern_am: ድንገተኛ መደረቅ እና የቅርንጫፎች መገርጠት፤ በእንጨቱ ውስጥ ጥቁር ሰማያዊ ጅራቶች፤ የተክሉ ሞት።
advice: Uproot and burn infected trees immediately to prevent spread.
Sterilize pruning tools between trees with flame or bleach.
Use certified disease-free seedlings for replanting.
advice_am: ስርጭትን ለመከላከል የተያዙ ዛፎችን ወዲያውኑ ቆፍረው ያቃጥሉ።
በዛፎች መካከል የመቁረጫ መሳሪያዎችን በእሳት ወይም ብሊች ያጸዱ።
ለመትከል የተረጋገጡ ከበሽታ ነጻ ችግኞችን ይጠቀሙ።
classes.canopy_advisor: Under enset canopy, remove wilted coffee stems promptly and avoid wounding trunks during shade work.
classes.canopy_advisor_am: በእንሰት ጥላ ስር የደረቁ የቡና ግንዶችን በፍጥነት ያስወግዱ እና በጥላ ስራ ወቅት ግንዱን ከመቁሰል ይቆጠቡ።
classes.seasonality: Year-round; peaks after heavy rain or drought stress.
classes.seasonality_am: ዓመቱን ሙሉ፤ ከከባድ ዝናብ ወይም ድርቅ ጫና በኋላ ይባሳል።
classes.transmission: Infected seedlings, contaminated pruning tools, and soil.
classes.transmission_am: የተያዙ ችግኞች፣ የተበከሉ የመቁረጫ መሳሪያዎች እና አፈር።
classes.yield_impact: Plant death within months; whole farms can be affected.
classes.yield_impact_am: በወራት ውስጥ የተክል ሞት፤ ሙሉ እርሻዎች ሊጠቁ ይችላሉ።
home_remedies: Traditional: burn wilted stumps and leave the hole open to sunlight for the whole dry season.
Easy: dip your machete in fire or bleach between every single tree — it costs nothing but discipline.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ የደረቁ ጉቶዎችን ያቃጥሉ እና ጉድጓዱን ለደረቅ ወቅት ሙሉ ለፀሀይ ይክፈቱ።
ቀላል፡ በእያንዳንዱ ዛፍ መካከል መቁረጫዎን በእሳት ወይም ብሊች ይንከሩ — ነጻ ነው ነገር ግን ቅድሚያ ይጠይቃል።
prevention_tips: Use only certified disease-free seedlings.
Avoid wounding trunks during weeding or shade work.
prevention_tips_am: የተረጋገጡ ከበሽታ ነጻ ችግኞችን ብቻ ይጠቀሙ።
በአረም ማጽዳት ወይም በጥላ ስራ ወቅት ግንዶችን ከመቁሰል ይቆጠቡ።

classes.name: Maize Lethal Necrosis
classes.regional_stats: Emerging threat in East Africa; causes severe yield loss and plant death.
classes.regional_stats_am: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ እየተስፋፋ ያለ ስጋት፤ ከባድ የምርት ኪሳራ እና የተክል ሞት ያስከትላል።
classes.traditional_practices: Roguing infected plants and controlling insect vectors are key farmer responses.
classes.traditional_practices_am: የተያዙ ተክሎችን መንቀል እና የነፍሳት ተሸካሚዎችን መቆጣጠር ቁልፍ የገበሬ ምላሾች ናቸው።
classes.visual_pattern: Yellowing and necrosis of leaves with severe stunting; dead heart; plant death.
classes.visual_pattern_am: የቅጠሎች መገርጠት እና ኔክሮሲስ ከከባድ ድውየት ጋር፤ የልብ መሞት፤ የተክል ሞት።
advice: Rogue and destroy infected plants immediately to reduce virus spread.
Control insect vectors (thrips, aphids, beetles) that transmit the virus.
Rotate with non-cereal crops and use certified seed.
advice_am: የቫይረስ ስርጭትን ለመቀነስ የተያዙ ተክሎችን ወዲያውኑ ቆፍረው ያጥፉ።
ቫይረሱን የሚያስተላልፉ ነፍሳትን (ትሪፕስ፣ አፊድ፣ ጥንዚዛ) ይቆጣጠሩ።
ከእህል ሰብሎች ጋር ይቀያይሩ እና የተረጋገጠ ዘር ይጠቀሙ።
classes.seasonality: Warm season; spreads rapidly with insect vectors.
classes.seasonality_am: ሞቃት ወቅት፤ ከነፍሳት ተሸካሚዎች ጋር በፍጥነት ይተላለፋል።
classes.transmission: Thrips, aphids, beetles, and infected seed.
classes.transmission_am: ትሪፕስ፣ አፊድ፣ ጥንዚዛ እና የተያዘ ዘር።
classes.yield_impact: 50–100% loss; plants may die before harvest.
classes.yield_impact_am: 50–100% ኪሳራ፤ ተክሎች ከመኸር በፊት ሊሞቱ ይችላሉ።
classes.monitoring_frequency: Weekly; act on the first yellowing leaf.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ፤ በመጀመሪያው ቢጫ ቅጠል እርምጃ ይውሰዱ።
home_remedies: Traditional: plant maize early so the crop matures before insect pressure peaks.
Easy: pull out and destroy any sick plant the moment you see it — one plant saved is the whole field.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ ሰብሉ ከነፍሳት ጫና በፊት እንዲበስል በቆሎን ቀድመው ይትከሉ።
ቀላል፡ የታመመ ተክል ሲያዩ ወዲያውኑ ቆፍረው ያጥፉ — አንድ የተከለለ ተክል ሙሉ እርሻን ያድናል።
prevention_tips: Rotate with beans and use certified seed.
Control weeds that host the insect vectors.
prevention_tips_am: ከባቄላ ጋር ይቀያይሩ እና የተረጋገጠ ዘር ይጠቀሙ።
ነፍሳትን የሚያስተናግዱ አረሞችን ይቆጣጠሩ።

classes.name: Enset Mealybug
classes.regional_stats: Extremely widespread in Gurage; often acts in tandem with root nematodes.
classes.regional_stats_am: በጉራጌ እጅግ በስፋት ይገኛል፤ ብዙ ጊዜ ከስር ኔማቶድ ጋር አብሮ ይሰራል።
classes.traditional_practices: Wood ash application around the corm base is the most common farmer control.
classes.traditional_practices_am: በግንዱ ስር የእንጨት አመድ መርጨት የተለመደ የገበሬ መቆጣጠሪያ ነው።
classes.seasonality: Year-round; worse in dry spells when plants are stressed.
classes.seasonality_am: ዓመቱን ሙሉ፤ ተክሎች በሚጨነቁበት ደረቅ ወቅት የባሰ ነው።
classes.transmission: Infested planting material, soil movement, and ants that farm the mealybugs.
classes.transmission_am: የተያዘ የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ፣ የአፈር እንቅስቃሴ እና ሜሊባግን የሚያሳድጉ ጉንዳኖች።
classes.yield_impact: Stunted growth and drying of young plants; reduced corm yield.
classes.yield_impact_am: የወጣት ተክሎች ድውየት እና መድረቅ፤ የግንድ ምርት መቀነስ።
classes.monitoring_frequency: Monthly; check the corm base and root zone for white waxy insects.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በየወሩ፤ በግንዱ ስር እና በስር አካባቢ ነጭ ሰም ያላቸው ነፍሳትን ይፈትሹ።
classes.visual_pattern: Leaf yellowing and stunting; white waxy mealybug clusters at the corm base and roots.
classes.visual_pattern_am: የቅጠል መገርጠት እና ድውየት፤ በግንዱ ስር እና በስሮች ላይ ነጭ ሰም ያላቸው የሜሊባግ ስብስቦች።
advice: Uncover the upper corm/root area and apply a generous layer of fresh, dry wood ash directly around the base.
Remove and destroy heavily infested plants to stop spread to healthy mats.
Avoid moving soil or planting material from infested gardens to clean fields.
advice_am: የላይኛውን ግንድ/ስር አካባቢ ከፍተው ትኩስ ደረቅ የእንጨት አመድ በቀጥታ በስሩ ይረጩ።
ወደ ጤናማ እንሰቶች እንዳይስፋፋ በጣም የተያዙ ተክሎችን አስወግደው ያጥፉ።
ከተያዙ አትክልቶች ወደ ንጹህ እርሻ አፈር ወይም የመትከያ ቁሳቁስ ከማንቀሳቀስ ይቆጠቡ።
home_remedies: Traditional: dust fine wood ash over the corm base — it dries out and kills the soft-bodied mealybugs.
Easy: spray a garlic + hot pepper + soap water mix on the base to repel young mealybugs.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ በግንዱ ስር የእንጨት አመድ ይረጩ — ሜሊባግን ያደርቃል እና ይገድላል።
ቀላል፡ የነጭ ሽንኩርት + በርበሬ + ሳሙና ውሃ በስሩ ይረጩ።
prevention_tips: Only take suckers from clean, healthy mother plants.
Keep the base free of weeds and debris where ants can nest.
prevention_tips_am: ችግኞችን ከንጹህ ጤናማ እናት ተክሎች ብቻ ይውሰዱ።
ጉንዳኖች የሚኖሩበትን አረም እና ቅሪት ከስሩ ያጽዱ።

classes.name: Enset Black Leaf Spot
classes.visual_pattern: Dark brown to black soot-like spots scattered across the leaf surface; affected leaves dry prematurely.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በቅጠል ላይ የሚታዩ ጥቁር እንደ ሻጋታ ነጠብጣቦች፤ የተጠቁ ቅጠሎች በእጅጉ ድርቅ።
advice: Remove and destroy heavily spotted leaves to reduce spore spread.
Improve airflow by removing weeds and overcrowded plants.
Where available, apply a registered fungicide at the first sign of spots.
advice_am: በእጅጉ የተጠቁ ቅጠሎችን ይቁረጡና ያስወግዱ።
የአየር ፍሰትን በማሻሻል ሽፋንን ይቀንሱ።
ካለ የተፈቀደ ፈንገስ መንከር በመጀመሪያው ምልክት ላይ ይጠቀሙ።
home_remedies: Traditional: sprinkle wood ash around the base of plants to suppress spore spread.
Easy: pick off and burn the most-spotted leaves by hand — free and immediate.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ የእንጨት አመድ ዙሪያቸውን ይረጩ።
ቀላል፡ በእጅ የተጠቁ ቅጠሎችን ቆርጠው ያቃጥሉ።
prevention_tips: Space plants widely and keep the field weed-free for good airflow.
Avoid working among wet leaves, which spreads spores.
prevention_tips_am: ተክሎችን በስፋት ያርቁ እና ጥሩ የአየር ፍሰት ይጠብቁ።
ቅጠሎች ሲኖሩ በርቷቸው ላይ አይሰሩ።
classes.seasonality: Humid periods and dense canopy; worst in the main rainy season.
classes.seasonality_am: በእርጥበት ወቅት እና ጥቅጥቅ ያለ ሽፋን፤ በዋናው የዝናብ ወቅት ከባድ።
classes.transmission: Fungal spores spread by rain splash, wind, and wet tools/hands.
classes.transmission_am: በዝናብ ውርጭ፣ በነፋስ እና በእርጥብ መሳሪያዎች ይተላለፋል።
classes.yield_impact: Premature leaf drying reduces kocho yield modestly if unmanaged.
classes.monitoring_frequency: Every two weeks during humid periods.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በእርጥበት ወቅት በሁለት ሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ።

classes.name: Enset Leaf Tip Dieback
classes.visual_pattern: Yellowing, browning, and drying that starts at leaf tips and margins and moves inward; no bacterial ooze.
classes.visual_pattern_am: ከቅጠል ጫፍ እና ጠርዝ ጀምሮ የሚታይ ቢጫነት፣ ቡናማነት እና ድርቅ፤ የባክቴሪያ ፈሳሽ የለም።
advice: Water deeply during dry spells and mulch around the base to hold moisture.
Apply well-rotted manure or compost to correct nutrient shortfall.
Rule out bacterial wilt: check a cut pseudostem for yellow ooze before treating as stress.
advice_am: በድርቅ ወቅት ውሃ ይጠጡ እና ዙሪያቸውን በማቆያ እርጥበት ይጠብቁ።
የተበሰበሰ ሌምም ወይም ኮማፖስት በመጨመር የአፈር ንጥረ ነገር ያስተካክሉ።
የባክቴሪያ ዊልትን ያስወግዱ፡ ግንዱን ቆርጠው ቢጫ ፈሳሽ መኖሩን ያረጋግጡ።
home_remedies: Traditional: work burnt ash and manure into the soil around affected mats.
Easy: grass mulch around the base keeps roots cool and moist — costs nothing.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ አመድ እና ሌምም በአፈሩ ውስጥ ይቀላቅሉ።
ቀላል፡ ሣር በስሩ ማሰራጨት ሙቀትንና እርጥበትን ይጠብቃል።
prevention_tips: Mulch and irrigate before the dry season begins.
Keep enset plots fertile — stressed plants show worse dieback.
prevention_tips_am: ከደረቅ ወቅት መጀመሪያ በፊት ማቆያ ይጣሉ እና ያጠጡ።
የእንሰት እርሻዎችን ለም ይጠብቁ።
classes.seasonality: Most visible in the dry season (December–February) and on poor soils.
classes.seasonality_am: በደረቅ ወቅት (ታኅሣሥ–የካቲት) እና በድህን አፈር ላይ ከባድ።
classes.transmission: Not transmissible — caused by water or nutrient stress.
classes.transmission_am: አይተላለፍም — በውሃ ወይም በንጥረ ነገር ጥለት ይከሰታል።
classes.yield_impact: Minor if corrected early; prolonged stress reduces kocho quality.
classes.yield_impact_am: በጊዜው ከተስተካከለ ትንሽ፤ ረዘሞ ጥለት የኩቾ ጥራት ይቀንሳል።
classes.monitoring_frequency: Monthly; increase in the dry season.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: በወር አንድ ጊዜ፤ በደረቅ ወቅት ብዙ።

classes.name: Coffee Leaf Miner
classes.visual_pattern: Dry, whitish winding tunnels and papery window-like patches inside leaves; early leaf drop in heavy attacks.
classes.visual_pattern_am: በቅጠል ውስጥ ነጭ ጠማማ መቆፈሪያ መስመሮች እና እንደ መስኮት ነጠብጣቦች፤ በእጅጉ ሲያዝ ቅጠል መንቀል።
advice: Collect and destroy severely mined leaves along with the larvae inside.
Encourage natural enemies by avoiding broad-spectrum insecticide sprays.
In heavy outbreaks, apply a registered, targeted insecticide following the label.
advice_am: በእጅጉ የተጠቁ ቅጠሎችን ከእንሰሳው ጋር ይሰብስቡና ያጠፉ።
የተፈጥሯዊ ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመጠበቅ ሰፊ የመንከር መርዝ አይጠቀሙ።
በእጅጉ ሲያዝ የተፈቀደ ንክክል መንከር በመመሪያው መሠረት ይጠቀሙ።
home_remedies: Traditional: hand-pick mined leaves early in the morning when larvae sit near the surface.
Easy: a neem leaf or seed soak sprayed weekly deters egg-laying moths.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ ጠዋት ጠዋት የተቆፈሩ ቅጠሎችን በእጅ ይንቀሉ።
ቀላል፡ የኦዲንጂ ቅጠል መርጫ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ይርጩ።
prevention_tips: Maintain balanced shade to discourage moth population booms.
Remove fallen mined leaves from around the trees.
prevention_tips_am: መጠነኛ ጥላ ይጠብቁ።
የወደቁ የተጠቁ ቅጠሎችን ከዛፎቹ ዙሪያ ያስወግዱ።
classes.seasonality: Warm, dry periods between rainy seasons.
classes.seasonality_am: በዝናብ ዘመናት መካከል ባሉ ሞቅ ያሉ ደረቅ ጊዜያት።
classes.transmission: Adult moths fly between trees; larvae spread within leaves.
classes.transmission_am: ብርቱካንማ ቢንባቦች በበረራ በዛፎች መካከል ይተላለፋሉ።
classes.yield_impact: Early leaf drop can reduce cherry yield by 10–30% in severe years.

classes.name: Coffee Sooty Mold
classes.visual_pattern: Black, charcoal-like powdery coating smothering the leaf surface; rubs off easily and often follows sap-sucking insects.
classes.visual_pattern_am: የቅጠል ላይን የሚሸፍን ጥቁር እንደ ከሰል ዱቄት፤ በቀላሉ ይሰርዛል።
advice: Control the sap-sucking insects (scale, mealybug, aphids) whose honeydew feeds the mold.
Wash or brush off light mold coatings; leaves recover once the source is gone.
Prune dense branches to improve light and airflow.
advice_am: ሻጋታውን የሚመግቡ እንስሳትን ይቆጣጠሩ።
ቀላል ሻጋታ በማጠብ ወይም በመሸራበት ያስወግዱ።
ቅርንጫፎችን በመከርከም ብርሃንና የአየር ፍሰት ያሳድጉ።
home_remedies: Traditional: soapy water from local bar soap sprayed on coated leaves loosens the mold.
Easy: wipe coated leaves with a damp cloth on young trees — immediate relief.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ የሳሙና ውሃ በመርጨት ሻጋታውን ያላቅቁ።
ቀላል፡ በእርጥብ ጨርቅ ይሸርብሸሩ።
prevention_tips: Monitor for scale insects and mealybugs — controlling them prevents the mold.
Avoid excessive shade; keep trees vigorous.
prevention_tips_am: የመጠቀሻ እንስሳትን ይቆጣጠሩ።
ብዙ ጥላ ያስወግዱ፤ ዛፎችን ጤናማ ያድርጉ።
classes.seasonality: Follows honeydew-producing insects; peaks in warm, still weather.
classes.seasonality_am: የንብ ማምረቻ እንስሳትን ተከትሎ፤ በሙቅ አየር ከፍ ይላል።
classes.transmission: Mold spores settle on honeydew; the insects that produce honeydew spread it.
classes.transmission_am: የሻጋታ ስፖሮች በንብ ጥለት ላይ ይወድቃሉ።
classes.yield_impact: Blocks sunlight and reduces photosynthesis; loss tracks the insect outbreak.
classes.yield_impact_am: ብርሃንን ይዘጋል፤ ኪሳራው ከእንስሳው አደጋ ጋር ይሄዳል።

classes.name: Common Corn Rust
classes.visual_pattern: Small, circular orange to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces; leaves a powdery residue on fingers.
classes.visual_pattern_am: ትንንሽ ክብ ብርቱካንማ-ቡናማ ዱቄታማ እብጥቦች በሁለቱም የቅጠል ገጽ።
advice: Scout weekly; if pustules cover the upper leaves before grain fill, apply a registered fungicide.
Bury or compost maize residue after harvest to break the disease cycle.
Plant tolerant hybrids next season in affected fields.
advice_am: በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ይመርምሩ፤ ስርጭት ሲሰፋ ፈንገስ መንከር ይጠቀሙ።
ከመከር በኋላ የበቆሎ ቅሪትን ቆፍረው ይቅበሩ።
በሚቀጥለው ወቅት የመከላከያ ዝርያዎችን ይዝሩ።
home_remedies: Traditional: rotate maize plots away from last season's field — rust spores die without a host.
Easy: remove and burn the first few rusted plants you find to slow the spread.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ የበቆሎ እርሻን ከወቅቱ መስክ ያርቁ።
ቀላል፡ የመጀመሪያዎቹን የተጠቁ ተክሎች ቆርጠው ያቃጥሉ።
prevention_tips: Plant early so grain fill finishes before cool, humid rust weather.
Avoid very dense sowing, which keeps leaves wet.
prevention_tips_am: ቀድመው ይዝሩ።
በጣም ጥቅጥቅ ያለ መዝራት ያስወግዱ።
classes.seasonality: Cool nights with dew and moderate humidity — typically mid to late season.
classes.seasonality_am: ቀዝቃዛ ሌሊቶች እና ጠዋት እርጥበት — በወቅቱ መሃል እና መጨረሻ።
classes.transmission: Rust spores travel long distances on the wind.
classes.yield_impact: Heavy rust on upper leaves can cut grain fill by 10–25%.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: ከወቅቱ መሃል ጀምሮ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ።

classes.name: Maize Streak Virus (MSV)
classes.visual_pattern: Long, narrow white to yellow streaks running parallel along the veins; severe stunting and small cobs in young plants.
classes.visual_pattern_am: ከቅጠል ዙሪያ ጋር በተመሳሳይ አቅጣጫ የሚሮጡ ረጅም ነጭ-ቢጫ መስመሮች፤ ከባድ እድገት ማቆም።
advice: Uproot and destroy severely streaked young plants — they never recover.
Control leafhopper vectors: clear grass weeds in and around the field.
Plant resistant/tolerant varieties in areas with known MSV history.
advice_am: በእጅጉ የተጠቁ ወጣት ተክሎችን ቆፍረው ያስወግዱ — እነሱ አይታከሙም።
የተቀናጁ ተባዮችን ይቆጣጠሩ፡ በእርሻው ውስጥና ዙሪያ ሣር ያስወግዱ።
በታሪክ በሚታወቁ አካባቢዎች የመከላከያ ዝርያዎችን ይዝሩ።
home_remedies: Traditional: early removal of streaked plants protects the rest of the stand.
Easy: keep field edges clear of tall grass where leafhoppers breed.
home_remedies_am: ባህላዊ፡ የተጠቁ ተክሎችን በጊዜው ማስወገድ ቀሪውን ይጠብቃል።
ቀላል፡ የመስክ ጠርዞችን ከሣር ንጹህ ያድርጉ።
prevention_tips: Plant at the start of the rains so seedlings grow quickly past the vulnerable stage.
Remove volunteer maize and grass weeds that harbour leafhoppers.
Use certified seed of tolerant varieties.
prevention_tips_am: በዝናብ መጀመሪያ ላይ ይዝሩ።
የተረፉ ተክሎችንና ሣር ያስወግዱ።
የመከላከያ ዝርያዎችን ይጠቀሙ።
classes.seasonality: Early season, when leafhoppers move from grasses to young maize.
classes.seasonality_am: የመጀመሪያው ወቅት፣ ተቀናጆች ከሣር ወደ ወጣት በቆሎ ሲቀየሩ።
classes.transmission: Leafhoppers (Cicadulina spp.) carry the virus from grass weeds to maize.
classes.transmission_am: ተቀናጆች ቫይረሱን ከሣር ወደ በቆሎ ይተላለፉ።
classes.yield_impact: Early infection can cause 30–100% grain loss on affected plants.
classes.monitoring_frequency: Twice weekly for the first month after emergence.
classes.monitoring_frequency_am: ከመቅለት በኋላ በመጀመሪያው ወር በሳምንት ሁለት ጊዜ።
